description: Create the Vite + React + TypeScript project scaffold manually by writing all necessary configuration and source files. Since INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network prevents npm install, all files are hand-written to match what 'npm create vite@latest chores-app -- --template react-ts' would generate, with boilerplate cleaned out (no default Vite demo content).
steps: Create chores-app/package.json with React 18, TypeScript, Vite dependencies listed (react, react-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom, typescript, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react). Use React 18.x versions (e.g., ^18.3.1 for react/react-dom, ^18.3.0 for @types/react, ^18.3.1 for @types/react-dom). Use Vite 6.x (^6.0.0), @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.0, TypeScript ~5.6.0. Include scripts: dev, build, lint, preview. Set name to 'chores-app', private true, version 0.0.0, type module.

Create chores-app/tsconfig.json - the root tsconfig that references tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json via 'references' field. Should have no compilerOptions of its own, just files:[] and references.
Create chores-app/tsconfig.app.json - the app-level TypeScript config targeting ES2020, with jsx:react-jsx, module:ESNext, moduleResolution:bundler, strict:true, noEmit:true. Include src/ directory.
Create chores-app/tsconfig.node.json - the node-level TypeScript config for vite.config.ts. Target ES2022, module:ESNext, moduleResolution:bundler. Include vite.config.ts.
Create chores-app/vite.config.ts importing @vitejs/plugin-react and exporting defineConfig with react() plugin.
Create chores-app/index.html - standard Vite entry HTML file with a div#root and a script tag pointing to /src/main.tsx.
Create chores-app/src/vite-env.d.ts with the Vite client types triple-slash reference (/// <reference types='vite/client' />).
Create chores-app/src/main.tsx - clean entry point that renders App component into the root div using ReactDOM.createRoot.
Create chores-app/src/App.tsx - minimal clean component that renders a heading 'Household Chores' (no default Vite logos, counters, or demo content).
Create chores-app/src/App.css - empty or minimal CSS file (no Vite default styles).
Create chores-app/src/index.css - basic CSS reset/base styles (box-sizing border-box, margin 0, font-family sans-serif).
Create a .gitignore inside chores-app/ with standard entries: node_modules, dist, *.local, .env files.
Verify all files exist and have correct structure by listing the directory tree.
acceptance_criteria: chores-app/ directory exists under the repo root with all scaffold files
package.json contains correct React 18, Vite, TypeScript dependencies and scripts
tsconfig.json, tsconfig.app.json, and tsconfig.node.json are properly configured with references pattern
vite.config.ts imports and uses the React plugin
index.html has div#root and script module pointing to /src/main.tsx
src/main.tsx renders App into root using createRoot
src/App.tsx is a clean component with no Vite boilerplate (no logos, counters, or demo content)
src/App.css and src/index.css exist with no Vite default demo styles
src/vite-env.d.ts has the Vite client types reference
.gitignore covers node_modules, dist, and local env files
verification: Run 'find chores-app -type f | sort' to confirm all expected files exist

Run 'cat chores-app/package.json | node -e "const p=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'); const j=JSON.parse(p); console.log(j.dependencies.react, j.devDependencies.vite, j.scripts.dev)"' to verify package.json structure
Run 'node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('chores-app/tsconfig.json','utf8'))"' to verify tsconfig.json is valid JSON
Verify App.tsx does not contain 'useState' or 'logo' (no Vite boilerplate) via grep
findings: All 12 scaffold files created successfully. JSON validation passed for all tsconfig and package.json files. Initial tsconfig files had JSON comments which were removed since strict JSON.parse rejects them (TypeScript supports JSONC but the verification uses JSON.parse). App.tsx confirmed clean with no useState or logo references. No build or test verification possible due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (no node_modules).
